test_title: PYST 60: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held  On 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

My friend __vanished when the goons came__ to fight with me.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"vanish"** means to disappear suddenly and completely. (गायब होना)

 
 
• **Example:** The magician made the rabbit vanish into thin air.
 
 
 
• The word **"disappear"** means to cease to be visible. (ओझल हो जाना)
 
 
• **Example:** She watched him disappear around the corner.
 
 

Therefore, the correct sentence is*** 'My friend disappeared when the thugs arrived__ to fight with me'***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Mobilised when the thugs arrived** (जुटाए गए जब गुंडे पहुंचे): To organize or prepare for action.

 
 
• **Example:** The army was **mobilised when the threat became apparent.**
 
 
 
• **Condemned when the thugs arrived** (निंदा की जब गुंडे पहुंचे): To express complete disapproval of something.
 
 
• **Example:** The mayor **condemned the violent actions of the thugs **when they arrived.
 
 
 
• **Attacked when the thugs arrived** (हमला किया जब गुंडे पहुंचे): To take aggressive action against.
 
 
• **Example:** The guard was **attacked when the thugs arrived at the gate.**
